conversationId.description: Unique UUID of the active agent conversation.

workspacePaths.description: Absolute directory paths of the user's mounted workspaces; may be empty for a conversation without a workspace, or hold several roots in a multi-root IDE-extension session.

transcriptPath.description: Path to the conversation's transcript.jsonl under <app_data_dir>/brain/<conversationId>/.system_generated/logs/.

artifactDirectoryPath.description: Path to the directory containing the conversation's artifacts and screenshots.

modelName.description: Name or identifier of the model handling the invocation; optional because earlier builds did not document or send it. Before CLI 1.5.3 a session using a custom model could receive a placeholder or empty value, so a blank value means unknown.

lastUserInput.description: The most recent user prompt in the conversation; a documented common field (CLI 1.4.7, Antigravity App v2.28.0) that earlier builds omit.

hookEventName.description: Name of the event being handled. Added by CLI 1.5.4 according to its release notes but absent from the reference; its value set is undocumented, so it is not an identification discriminator.

cwd.description: The agent's working directory. Added by CLI 1.5.4 according to its release notes but absent from the reference; it is not the hook process's working directory, which for plugin hooks is the plugin root.

invocationNum.description: 0-indexed sequence number of the current model invocation; the first invocation is 0.

initialNumSteps.description: Number of steps currently in the trajectory.
